name: The National Archives (Kew)
description: Official national archive of the UK government and of England and Wales, based at Kew. Offers research guides for family history and the Discovery catalogue of its own and other UK archives' holdings.
access_evidence: Search results via nationalarchives.gov.uk record-copying page (WebSearch snippet): 'Digital records available to download in Discovery are currently free of charge'; record copying service supplies copies 'for a fee'; 'free to look at documents on site at Kew'. Homepage itself did not discuss fees.
limitations: Many family-history record sets (e.g., census, BMD indexes) are made available via commercial partners rather than directly; homepage does not state pricing.

search_link.how_verified: Loaded https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/results/r?_q=Campbell in a browser on 2026-10-05: page titled 'Search results: Campbell | The National Archives' showing 'Records 580,152'.

api_notes: Not checked (TNA has historically offered a Discovery API; not verified in this pass).
notes: Copy access derived from search-result snippets of TNA's own record-copying page, not a direct fetch. Record types listed are widely known TNA holdings, not quoted from fetched pages.

name: Discovery catalogue
description: TNA's online catalogue, describing records held at TNA and at thousands of other UK archives, with a subset of records digitised and downloadable.
access_evidence: Discovery home: 'more than 37 million descriptions of records held by The National Archives and more than 3,500 archives across the country'; 'Over 9 million records are available for download.' TNA record-copying page (search snippet): downloads 'currently free of charge'.
limitations: Catalogue descriptions only for most items; only part of the holdings are digitised. Download pricing taken from search snippet, not direct fetch.

search_link.how_verified: Browser test with _q=Campbell returned 'Search results for Campbell', Records 580,152, Record creators 402 (2026-10-05).

notes: WebFetch returned blank (JS/bot protection); verified via in-app browser.

name: FreeBMD
description: Volunteer-transcribed index to the civil registration births, marriages and deaths of England and Wales. A Free UK Genealogy project.
access_evidence: Homepage: 'We do not make any charge whatsoever for use of the site and we never ask for credit card details to do a search.'
limitations: Homepage: 'WE HAVE NOT YET TRANSCRIBED THE WHOLE PERIOD'; 'We make no warranty whatsoever as to the accuracy or completeness'. Coverage chart at /progress.shtml.

search_link.how_verified: Search form at /cgi/search.pl uses HTTP POST (fields include surname, given, start, end, districtid, type); no GET URL template found.

notes: FreeBMD indexes GRO quarterly index pages; certificates are ordered from the GRO, not FreeBMD (not verified on page). Scanned index page images may be linked but were not checked.

name: FreeCEN
description: Free, volunteer-transcribed searchable database of 19th/early-20th-century British census returns. A Free UK Genealogy project.
access_evidence: Homepage presents free search; asks users to 'verify any result with the actual census at your local library or similar resource'.
limitations: 'errors exist in both the original census and the transcription'; 'Search times are limited to 100 seconds'; no warranty as to completeness. Transcriptions only, no images.
notes: Homepage stated a record count; deliberately not stored.

name: FreeREG
description: Free, volunteer-transcribed index of parish register baptisms, marriages and burials, mainly for England and Wales with some Scotland, Ireland, Channel Islands and Isle of Man.
access_evidence: Homepage: free search; 'The FreeREG database is just a finding tool' and users should verify with 'a copy of the register at your local library, County Record Office, Family History Society'.
limitations: 'just a finding tool'; transcription errors possible; 'Search times are limited to 100 seconds'. No overall date range stated.

name: ScotlandsPeople
page_title: Explore your Scottish Heritage | Scotland's People
description: Official Scottish government genealogy site with indexes and pay-per-view images of statutory registers, church registers, census returns, wills and other records.
access_evidence: 'Our charges' page: '1 credit is worth 25p'; statutory registers, census returns, church registers cost 6 credits to view; wills 10 credits; some 'free-to-view Virtual Volumes records'. Search snippet: indexes searchable free; account free.

date_ranges.label: Statutory births 100+ yrs, marriages 75+ yrs, deaths 50+ yrs old available as images

limitations: Pay-per-view by credits; recent statutory records closed (100/75/50-year rules). 'Access' value 'paid_retrieval' here means pay-per-view credits; no subscription model was seen.
unverified_fields: date_ranges (OPR pre-1855 / statutory from 1855 widely known but not quoted)
notes: Homepage notes newly added records of 262 congregations that broke from the Church of Scotland. Credit prices taken from 'Our charges' page fetched 2026-10-05.

provider: Department of Culture, Communications and Sport (Ireland)
name: IrishGenealogy.ie
description: Irish government site giving free access to historic civil registration registers/indexes and to transcribed church records for selected areas (e.g., Dublin, Kerry, Cork & Ross).
access_evidence: Site blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare). Per search snippets (irishgenealogy.ie, secondary sources): civil register indexes and images free; births >100 yrs, marriages >75 yrs, deaths >50 yrs.

date_ranges.label: Civil deaths (rolling 50-year rule; online images start date varies by source)

limitations: Data-protection windows (100/75/50 years). Church records only for some dioceses/counties.
notes: Secondary sources disagree on online end dates; store rolling rules rather than fixed end years.

name: National Archives of Ireland (incl. census search)
description: Official repository of Irish State records. Its site hosts free searches of the 1901 and 1911 censuses, surviving 1821-1851 census fragments, and the 1926 census (released in phases).
access_evidence: Homepage: 'It's free to visit and research in the Reading Room.' Census search pages carry no payment requirement. Census page: 'This form searches 1901 and 1911 census data only'; separate 1926 form ('Phased release of Census 1926 information').
limitations: 1926 census released in phases. Census search now at nationalarchives.ie/collections/search-the-census/ (older census.nationalarchives.ie domain not checked).
unverified_fields: access.images (census images assumed from well-known site; not confirmed on page)
terminology (Tithe Applotment not on fetched pages)
notes: 1926 Irish census is now live on NAI site (phased); worth highlighting.

name: Library and Archives Canada - Genealogy and Collection Search
description: Canada's federal library and archive. Its genealogy section guides research in censuses, immigration, military, land and citizenship records, with Census Search and Collection Search tools.
access_evidence: Genealogy page lists census, BMD, immigration, military, citizenship, land records. Search snippets of LAC pages: census images and indexes 'searchable online for free through Census Search'; digitised items downloadable from the item viewer (single image or PDF).
record_types: military personnel files (incl. First World War CEF)
limitations: Collection Search excludes census records and standalone databases (per LAC 'Using Collection search' snippet). Collection Search site blocked automated fetch (403).

search_link.how_verified: recherche-collection-search.bac-lac.gc.ca returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; no template verified.

name: Archives of Ontario
description: Ontario's provincial archives, holding vital statistics registrations, land and court records. Much of its vital statistics material is accessed via FamilySearch and Ancestry.
access_evidence: Homepage: 'Order a copy of a birth, marriage or death registration'; FamilySearch: 'Most of our vital statistics and some court records are available online'; Ancestry Ontario BMD 'free at the Archives' reading room.
limitations: Vital statistics online mainly through third parties (FamilySearch with free account; Ancestry, subscription or free onsite).

search_link.how_verified: Not tested; site uses Radware bot protection for curl.

provider: Bibliothèque et Archives nationales du Québec
name: BAnQ - Archives nationales / Advitam
page_title: BAnQ : Bibliothèque et Archives nationales du Québec
description: Quebec's national library and archives. Its Advitam tool searches archival holdings from New France to the present, and its état civil pages provide access to baptism, marriage and burial records.
access_evidence: Homepage: Advitam 'L'outil de recherche pour découvrir tous les trésors des Archives nationales'; état civil: 'Obtenez des actes de baptême, mariage et sépulture'. Some digital resources require login or subscription (details not stated).
limitations: État civil page blocked by Radware for automated access; image access terms unverified.

name: Trove
description: National Library of Australia discovery service giving free access to digitised Australian newspapers and gazettes plus collections of many Australian libraries.
access_evidence: Trove pages via search snippets: 'Searching Trove is free to users anywhere in the world'; 'Newspapers & Gazettes' category 'entirely made up of freely available online material'; newspapers from 1803, generally digitised to 1954.
limitations: Site protected by an Anubis proof-of-work bot check; direct fetch refused. OCR errors common (well known, not quoted).

search_link.how_verified: Not verified: the browser test hit Trove's 'Making sure you're not a bot!' check and I did not proceed past it; WebFetch got 'Access Denied'.

api_notes: Documented API (v3) per Trove 'Using the API' and 'API technical guide' pages (search snippets): requires an API key, issued after signing up for a free Trove account and submitting a request form (declaring usage, call rate, agreeing to Terms of Use).

name: NSW State Archives Collection
description: NSW Government records from 1788 to today, managed by Museums of History NSW, with online indexes (convicts, assisted immigrants, 1841 census, gaol photos) and research guides.
access_evidence: Page: 'Online indexes, research guides & webinars are listed in Subjects A-Z. You can also search all the indexes at once via the catalogue.' Gaol photos index: 'download digitised photos from 1870 to 1930'. Reading Room at Kingswood.
limitations: Copy ordering terms not checked.

name: Public Record Office Victoria (PROV)
description: Archive of the Victorian state and local governments, with records from 1836, many accessible online or in reading rooms. Family-history guides cover wills and probates, inquests, passenger records and wards of state.
access_evidence: Homepage: 'more than 110 km of physical records and 1.5 million digital records from 1836 to the present day. Many records are accessible to the public either online or for viewing in our Reading Rooms.'
limitations: Not all records digitised; copy ordering terms not checked.

name: National Library of NZ - Family history guide
page_title: Family history | National Library of New Zealand
description: Research guide covering NZ birth, death and marriage sources, burials, wills/probate, arrivals by ship, military, land and newspapers, plus onsite resources and FamilySearch access at the Library.
access_evidence: Guide sections include 'BDM resources available onsite at the Library' and 'FamilySearch at the National Library'; points to subscription databases (NZSG Kiwi Collection, PressReader, Newztext).
limitations: A guide rather than a record database.
unverified_fields: record_types (electoral rolls/directories not confirmed in fetched excerpt)

name: Papers Past
description: Free full-text digitised NZ and Pacific newspapers from the 19th and 20th centuries, plus magazines, letters and diaries, parliamentary papers (AJHR) and books.
access_evidence: Searches and article pages loaded without login; homepage: 'Discover New Zealand and Pacific history through digitised full-text collections.'
terminology: AJHR (Appendices to the Journals of the House of Representatives)
limitations: Newspaper coverage limited to titles digitised; about page URL /newspapers/about returned 'can't find that page'.

search_link.how_verified: Browser: ?query=Campbell showed 'Showing results 1-10 of 2,268,688'; adding start_date=01-01-1880&end_date=31-12-1890 showed filter '1 Jan 1880 to 31 Dec 1890' and 207,581 results with Campbell-titled hits (2026-10-05). Dates use DD-MM-YYYY; for year placeholders use 01-01-{year_from} and 31-12-{year_to}.

api_notes: Papers Past content is aggregated by DigitalNZ (not confirmed on fetched page). DigitalNZ has a documented API (v3); its getting-started page says 'You no longer need a key to access the DigitalNZ API.'
notes: WebFetch fails (redirect loop / 403); in-app browser works.

provider: Archives New Zealand / Te Rua Mahara o te Kāwanatanga
name: Archives New Zealand - Collections search
description: Archive of NZ government records from 1840 to the recent past. Collections search finds records; some are digitised, and others are viewed in reading rooms after preordering.
access_evidence: Collections site: 'Find records created by the government of Aotearoa New Zealand, from 1840 to the recent past'; 'You need to preorder records before you visit'; 'Photo ID is required'. Search snippet of archives.govt.nz: copying fees apply; probate files over 50 years old free online via FamilySearch (joint project).
limitations: Main site archives.govt.nz could not be fetched (blank/navigation denied). Copy fee amounts not stored.

name: Births, Deaths & Marriages Historical Records
page_title: Birth, Death and Marriage Historical Records
description: NZ government index of historical births, deaths and marriages, free to search, with paid printouts and certificates.
access_evidence: Page: free search; 'Receive your printouts by email'; 'Certificates will continue to be sent by mail.' Prices not shown on page.

date_ranges.label: Births 100+ yrs; deaths 50+ yrs (or born 80+ yrs ago per NatLib guide); marriages 75+ yrs

limitations: 'The historic data available for you to search is limited so that information relating to people who might still be alive, can be protected.'

name: Digitalarkivet
description: Arkivverket's free online archive service with searchable transcribed sources (censuses, church books, emigration) and scanned images of parish registers, probate, court and property records.
access_evidence: Person search and scanned images available without login (search tested 2026-10-05). Site notes some archives are restricted and require access requests to Nasjonalarkivet.
limitations: Some archives restricted. Person search capped display ('Your search resulted in 10,000 hits' for a common surname).

search_link.how_verified: Browser: /en/search/persons?s=Hansen returned 'Search for individuals' with 10,000 hits listing Hansen entries from 1920/1900/1865 censuses and church books (2026-10-05). Tested with Hansen, not Campbell.

unverified_fields: terminology: bygdebøker (published farm histories, not necessarily on Digitalarkivet)
notes: 'full_text' refers to the newer machine-read document search mentioned on the homepage.

name: Archion
description: Subscription portal for digitised Protestant church books from German (and some other) church archives, with downloads and automatic handwriting recognition.
access_evidence: Buy-access page: 1-month €19.90 (50 downloads), 3-month €52.20, 1-year €178.80; account required; 'View a Free Example from an Archive'.
record_types: Protestant church books: baptisms, marriages, burials, confirmations
limitations: Paid passes; download and text-recognition quotas per pass. Mostly image-browse by parish, not a full name index.
notes: Homepage stated collection size; not stored. Prices fetched 2026-10-05 and may change.

name: Matricula Online
description: Free portal of digitised Catholic church registers (mostly baptism, marriage and death books) from dioceses in several Central European countries, browsed by place.
access_evidence: 'Here you can find church registers (mostly books of birth, marriage, and death) from various European countries.' Browse by place/map; no payment indicated.
record_types: Catholic parish registers: baptisms, marriages, deaths
limitations: Image browse by parish only (no name index). Some records restricted under civil status and data-protection laws.

name: Geneanet
description: Large European-focused genealogy platform built on member trees, collaborative indexes (graves, records) and a library of digitised books and newspapers. Strongest for France.
access_evidence: Premium page: Premium 'From $4.55 per month' adds advanced search (spouse/parents, wildcards, name variants, nearby places), hints and alerts. Free tier: last name/first name/place search, unlimited free tree. Comparison table marks were not readable as text, so exactly which collections need Premium is unverified.
limitations: Contributed trees vary in quality; Premium needed for advanced search options.

search_link.how_verified: Browser: ?go=1&nom=Campbell&prenom=&size=10 titled 'Individual : CAMPBELL - Search all records' showing '1,708,656 results' (2026-10-05).

unverified_fields: access (free vs Premium split per collection)
notes: Ancestry ownership is a widely reported fact, not verified this pass; consider dropping from provider string.

name: JewishGen
page_title: JewishGen - The Home of Jewish Genealogy
description: Non-profit Jewish genealogy hub, a division of the Museum of Jewish Heritage, offering a unified search across many record databases (Holocaust, burial/JOWBR, town records) plus KehilaLinks, the Family Finder and research groups.
access_evidence: Homepage: 'The JewishGen site is offered as a free public resource.' Unified search page shows 'Login to JewishGen'; whether login is mandatory to see results was not confirmed.
regions: Worldwide; region filter lists ~40 countries/regions incl. Poland, Ukraine, Lithuania, Belarus, Hungary, Romania, Germany, UK, US
limitations: Unified search uses phonetic/fuzzy matching options.

search_link.how_verified: Unified search form (/databases/all/) POSTs to /databases/jgform.php (fields srch1, srch1v, srch1t, GeoRegion); no GET template found.

notes: The homepage and search page give different Holocaust record counts; none stored.
